scope: Test fixture/oracle failures remain retained. None is counted as a production regression or semantic mutant kill.

corrections.reason: The test initially guessed two-return StagedFile accessors and a nonexistent core error name. Correct calls use the actual compiler-owned projections and ErrFilestoreActivationIndeterminate.
A test enum arm and sink type initially shared one Go identifier; the fixture sink type now has its own identifier.

The initial missing-parent case placed the target and temporary in different parents, correctly receiving Contract. Both now share the same missing parent; the row proves native activation refusal before consuming source bytes.

A regular entry replacing a directory is refused by the Unix O_DIRECTORY acquisition with native ENOTDIR, not fs.ErrInvalid. Independent Go acquisition now supplies the platform-owned cause. This correction exposed the separate real cancellation defect without conflating it with the fixture error.
